rationale: The short thesis is fully intact — price remains well below session VWAP ($55.00) and the 9-EMA ($54.29), the risk-off tape has deepened (SPY -0.76%, VIXY +2.83%), and the last 1m bar closed on its low as price grinds toward the $53.05-$53.10 target zone only $0.29 away. There is no reversal evidence (no absorption at the lows, no VWAP reclaim, no new headline) to justify closing early, and flipping long would fight both the intraday trend and the tape. A full stop-out at $54.68 would realize only ~$142 of additional loss, keeping the day inside the remaining budget, so holding for the final leg to the target carries acceptable risk.
